title: For each network whose number of ports that are both in status 'DOWN' and h
question: For each network whose number of ports that are both in status 'DOWN' and have port security enabled is greater than the average such count across all networks, list the network ID, that down-and-secure port count (and the overall total of down-and-secure ports), and also the maximum (within that network) of the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allowed address-pair counts per port (considering only ports that have at least one allowed address pair). Do not return any rounded answers.

access_trace.sql:
WITH portsec AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.network_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1
),
net_counts AS (
  SELECT network_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM portsec
  GROUP BY network_id
),
avg_cnt AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM net_counts
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT p.network_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(aap.port_id) AS pair_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN allowedaddresspairs aap ON aap.port_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id
),
net_stats AS (
  SELECT network_id,
         MAX(pair_count) - MIN(pair_count) AS range_val,
         VAR_SAMP(pair_count) AS variance_val,
         STDDEV(pair_count) AS stddev_val
  FROM pair_counts
  GROUP BY network_id
)
SELECT nc.network_id AS network_id,
       nc.cnt AS down_secure_port_count,
       (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM net_counts) AS total_down_secure_ports,
       GREATEST(ns.range_val, ns.variance_val, ns.stddev_val) AS max_stat
FROM net_counts nc
JOIN net_stats ns ON ns.network_id = nc.network_id
WHERE nc.cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_cnt)
ORDER BY nc.network_id;
